name: Sustanon (testosterone blend)

card.summary: A blend of four testosterone esters in oil, marketed as Sustanon 250; discussed in bodybuilding circles, with no appearance trials behind it.
card.note: Prescription testosterone product; sources for this entry are thin.

quick.overview:
Sustanon is the brand name of mixed-ester testosterone injections. Sustanon 250 combines four testosterone esters (propionate, phenylpropionate, isocaproate and decanoate), and Sustanon 100 combines three of them (propionate, phenylpropionate and isocaproate).

The blend is intended to give a mix of faster and slower release. Little published research is available in the sources reviewed for this wiki, and none examines appearance outcomes.
quick.mechanism: Each ester is a prodrug that is cleaved to release testosterone after intramuscular injection; shorter esters act sooner and longer ones last longer, so a blend spreads release over time.
quick.risks: As with other testosterone products, general risks include acne, sperm suppression, raised red blood cell counts and cardiovascular and prostate considerations. Testosterone is a controlled substance in many countries.

lead: Sustanon is the brand name of a family of mixed-ester testosterone injections made by Organon. Sustanon 250 combines four testosterone esters (propionate, phenylpropionate, isocaproate and decanoate), and Sustanon 100 combines three of them (propionate, phenylpropionate and isocaproate).[1][3] It is a prescription testosterone replacement product, and it is also a long-standing name in bodybuilding circles, where testosterone is discussed for its effects on muscle mass and body composition, and so on how a physique looks.[3]

The idea behind the blend is staggered release: shorter esters act sooner and longer ones last longer, so one injection spreads testosterone out over time.[3][2] Wikipedia describes the usual medical schedule as every few weeks for Sustanon 250 and every two weeks for Sustanon 100, and notes the product is commonly prescribed for transmasculine people undergoing masculinising hormone therapy.[3]

In controlled research Sustanon 250 has been used in studies of testosterone and muscle: a double-blind trial in older men who combined it with resistance training reported greater fat-free mass gains and reduced fat mass than placebo.[4] No trial has examined Sustanon for cosmetic or appearance outcomes in healthy young men.

chain: Injected esters release testosterone over time
Androgen signalling raises muscle protein synthesis
More lean mass and less fat mass
angle.text: Testosterone products are used in medicine to restore levels and in bodybuilding circles to add lean mass, and a 2019 trial combining Sustanon with resistance training found larger gains in fat-free mass than placebo in older men.[4] In the looks context the payoff is a more muscular, leaner physique, alongside well-documented side effects.

paras: Sustanon is given by intramuscular injection as testosterone replacement.[3] Wikipedia reports that brief UK shortages occurred in late 2011 and mid-2012 because of manufacturing changes, and that the product is commonly used in masculinising hormone therapy for trans men.[3] Reviews of testosterone replacement list intramuscular Sustanon among the clinically available delivery forms, alongside gels, patches and long-acting depot injections.[5]

Wikipedia describes Sustanon as a popular anabolic steroid among bodybuilders during bulking phases.[3] In forum discussions, such as T Nation threads, users compare it with other ester blends and debate how the esters behave when injected at different frequencies.[6][7] This wiki does not give dosing or injection guidance.

The esters are prodrugs: they are cleaved after injection to release testosterone, and their different elimination half-lives give a sustained but non-linear release from the oil depot.[3][2] Testosterone ester blends in oil are the most common injectable route for replacement therapy.[2]

Anti-doping researchers studied the detection of Sustanon esters in blood. In a six-person clinical study that included a single Sustanon injection, intact esters could be followed in serum and plasma over a 60-day sampling window, which gives a way to prove exogenous testosterone use.[8]

General testosterone-therapy effects include acne, oily skin and hair loss, suppression of sperm production, and warnings about cardiovascular events, prostate conditions and blood pressure; testosterone is contraindicated in pregnancy.[2] Injectable oil preparations can cause pulmonary oil microembolism, with cough and shortness of breath.[2]

In healthy young men, androgen treatment with Sustanon suppressed circulating testosterone, LH and the Leydig cell marker INSL3 in a study of testicular suppression, consistent with the shutdown of the body's own testosterone production.[9] A 2024 paper in Translational Andrology and Urology reported that Sustanon suppresses spermatogenesis and increases cell death.[10]

A 2019 randomised, double-blind trial gave 18 healthy older men Sustanon or saline injections during six weeks of resistance training. The testosterone group gained more total, leg and appendicular fat-free mass and lost more fat mass than placebo, with improvements in muscle thickness and cross-sectional area reported.[4]

Other human studies used Sustanon as an experimental tool, including a six-man study of testicular suppression and a six-participant study of how long injected esters stay detectable in blood.[8][9] No studies were found of Sustanon for appearance in healthy young adults.

timeline.event: Brief UK shortage after a manufacturing site shift.[3]

lore.intro: Sustanon is discussed in lifting and TRT forums as a multi-ester option, with threads comparing it with other blends and asking how the esters behave over time.[6][7]

claims.claim: A multi-ester blend gives smoother, longer-lasting testosterone levels than a single ester
claims.believers: Forum users describe Sustanon as a four-component product intended to release over a long period, and compare similar blends to it.[11]
claims.experts: Pharmacology sources describe the different half-lives of the esters and the sustained but non-linear release of blends.[3]

claims.claim: Testosterone with training builds more muscle and less fat
claims.believers: Bodybuilders describe testosterone products as a route to a bigger, leaner physique.[3]
claims.experts: A double-blind trial found larger fat-free mass gains in older men given Sustanon with resistance training than in the placebo group.[4]

claims.claim: Stopping testosterone products leaves the body's own production intact
claims.believers: Some users report returning to normal after finishing.
claims.experts: Studies in healthy men show androgen treatment suppresses testosterone, LH and INSL3, and sperm-production suppression has been reported.[9][10]
